candidate_replay.comparison_method: Open-loop: baseline body/internal initial state and post-conditioning input tape; candidate aircraft mass/inertia/configuration and current solver. Not a newly trimmed flight or pilot adaptation.

metadata.aircraft_input_hash_convention: sha256 of exact aircraft input file bytes
metadata.aircraft_semantic_hash_convention: sha256 of Godot JSON.stringify(parsed_input, indent=empty, sort_keys=true, full_precision=false); not file bytes
metadata.continuous_layout: rpm; fuel kg, temperature K, servo, throttle opening, fuel transport kg/s, crank revolutions; running, reason, opportunities, fires, firing accumulator; mixture; shaft/prop/thrust/chemical work J; feed-line liquid mass kg; fuel source mode (0 starved, 1 main tank, 2 pre-primed line); wheel rim speeds in m/s, landing-gear contact order, appended continuous tail
metadata.frames: world NED (north, east, down); body FRD (forward, right, down); quaternion body->NED [w,x,y,z]
metadata.fuel_mass_policy: finite tank; uniform co-moving efflux; variable mass/CG/inertia; body datum remains initial wet CG
metadata.ground: 3 profiled spring-damper gear contacts on flat 0 m dry-pavement fixture; per-contact wheel radius and inertia, steering, continuous relative wheel spin; brakes off (no brake command exposed)
metadata.ground_effect_model: image-induced-factor-v1 (aero.ground_effect: strip induced angle/drag and tail downwash from the field terrain height, exact above 2.0 spans)
metadata.loads: Fx..Mz: body-axis loads excluding gravity; k1 at previous body/continuous endpoint and current sampled servos; includes relative-spin reaction
metadata.mass_reference: mass_kg and inertia_kgm2 are initial wet values; live mass/CG/inertia derive from continuous fuel at fixed initial datum
metadata.state_timing: body, continuous shaft RPM and mirrored aux at tick k; servos advance before RK4; shaft RPM/inflow/gyro/reaction evaluated at each stage
metadata.turbulence_interval: linear interpolation between exact OU tick samples; wall time tau; independent NED axes
metadata.weather_evidence: user-selected/authored practice conditions; not measured meteorology
metadata.weather_timing: wind/TAS at row state time; loads_* wind and loads_t_s describe k1 (tick-1 body/shaft, current sampled servos); reset uses t=0
metadata.wheel_profile_hash_convention: profile_sha256 is canonical JSON for the selected aircraft profile; input_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact wheel_profiles.json bytes
metadata.wing_polar_model: tabulated-wing-v1 (experimental finite-wing strip reference); spanwise stall progression g = 1.0
